problem.heading: Teen cheezein jo har dukaan mein roz hoti hain

items.title: Price poocha. Seen hua. Gayab.
items.body: Reply gaya, blue tick aaya, phir kuch nahi. Zyaadatar dukaandaar yahin ruk jaate hain. Customer busy tha, confused tha, ya bas bhool gaya. Usse ek wajah chahiye wapas aane ki.

items.title: Phone mein 800 numbers, business 40 se.
items.body: Purane customers ko mahino se koi message nahi gaya. Diwali ka offer 5 logon ko forward hua. Unhe wapas bulane ka koi fixed tareeka hi nahi hai.

items.title: Insta ads pe ₹5,000, WhatsApp pe ₹0 ka system.
items.body: Ads se log WhatsApp pe aate hain, par unhe sambhalne ka plan nahi hota. Paisa jaata hai, customer nahi aata. Pehle WhatsApp sahi karo, phir ads.

problem.solution: Iska fix koi naya app nahi hai. Ek system hai jo free WhatsApp Business app pe chalta hai: lao, convert karo, wapas bulao. Yeh ebook wahi system hai, 21 din mein, roz 15 minute.

steps.title: Roz ek chapter, 15 minute
steps.body: Har chapter ek kaam deta hai. Day 1 profile aur catalog, Day 10 follow up sequence, Day 15 pehla broadcast.

inside.heading: Andar kya hai
inside.sub: 6 parts, 14 chapters, 124 pages. Har chapter ke end mein ek kaam, 15 minute ka.

parts.label: Part 1
parts.title: Setup: free app ko dukaan banao
parts.body: Business profile, catalog, greeting aur away message, 10 quick replies, labels, wa.me link aur QR.

parts.label: Part 2
parts.title: Lao: naye local leads
parts.body: Consent ke saath number lena, counter board, Google profile, Instagram bio, status ka weekly plan, lead magnet ideas.

parts.label: Part 3
parts.title: Convert karo: scripts jo band karte hain
parts.body: 5 minute rule, price ka jawab, 3 message follow up, 5 objection scripts, close, review aur referral.

parts.label: Part 4
parts.title: Wapas bulao: broadcast system
parts.body: 256 ki limit, lists, anti ban rules, mahine ka 4 message rhythm, reminders jo repeat business laate hain.

parts.label: Part 5
parts.title: Season: festival aur local calendar
parts.body: Saal bhar ka calendar, 3 message festival template, 6 mahine se chup customers ke liye win back.

parts.label: Part 6
parts.title: Jab free app chhota pad jaaye
parts.body: Free app ki limits, 8 sawaal ka self assessment, WhatsApp Business Platform ka sach aur asli cost table.

honesty.heading: Yeh kya nahi hai

items.title: Raaton raat lakhpati scheme
items.body: Yahan koi hack nahi. Ek kaam karne ka plan hai, roz 15 minute.

items.title: Bulk spam tool
items.body: 5,000 anjaan numbers pe message bhejne se number ban hota hai. Consent, STOP line aur limits ka pura chapter hai.

items.title: Koi paid app ya software
items.body: Sab kuch free WhatsApp Business app se. Aage ka rasta bhi saaf saaf likha hai, bina dhakka diye.

items.title: Result ka vaada
items.body: System hamara, mehnat aapki. Jo roz karega, uske liye likha hai.

honesty.closing: Yeh guide un logon ke liye nahi hai jo raaton raat lakhpati banna chahte hain. Yeh unke liye hai jinke paas dukaan hai, customers hain, aur WhatsApp hai, aur jo teeno ko ek saath kaam pe lagana chahte hain.

faq.a: Payment ke turant baad download link WhatsApp aur email pe aata hai. Phone, tablet ya laptop, kahin bhi khul jaata hai.
Dono editions milti hain. Ek Hindi + English (Devanagari mein Hindi, English words English mein) aur ek Hinglish (Roman script). Jo aasaan lage, wahi padho.
Haan, isi ke liye banaya hai. A5 size ke page, badi type, har script ek bubble mein. Saath mein ek text file hai jisse messages seedha copy paste ho jaate hain.
Sirf free WhatsApp Business app. Chapter 1 mein normal WhatsApp se migrate karne ka tareeka hai, backup ke saath. Koi aur software nahi.

faq.q: Kya yeh bulk message ya spam tool hai?
faq.a: Nahi. Broadcast sirf unhe jaata hai jinhone number save kiya hai aur haan boli hai. Consent, STOP line, frequency aur anti ban rules ka pura chapter hai.
Nahi. Agar aap WhatsApp pe message bhej sakte ho, toh yeh sab kar sakte ho. Har step screen ke hisaab se likha hai.

faq.q: Mere business type ke liye hai?
faq.a: Coaching, clinic, salon, boutique, mobile shop, broker, travel agent, CA, home baker, Meesho seller: har script ke variants in sab ke liye hain.
Razorpay se: UPI, debit aur credit card, netbanking. Ek baar ka payment, koi subscription nahi.
7 din mein pasand na aaye toh poora paisa wapas. Support WhatsApp pe ek message bhejo.
